ADEPT.name: Adept
ADEPT.acquisition: Gateway + Cybernetics Core (powered); or Warp Gate + Cybernetics Core (powered).
ADEPT.description: Ranged ground attacker specialized against Light targets. Psionic Transfer scouts or threatens relocation, with cancellation avoiding an unsafe commitment. The shade is not an independent damaging unit. Adepts cannot attack aircraft and do not supply detection.

ARCHON.name: Archon
ARCHON.acquisition: Merge any two High Templar and/or Dark Templar; consumes both sources.
ARCHON.description: Shield-heavy splash ground/air unit formed from any two eligible Templar. The source casters and their individual spell kits are consumed. EMP and shield interactions matter; short range and footprint affect contact. It is not a separately purchased Gateway unit.

CARRIER.name: Carrier
CARRIER.description: Capital ship whose normal attacks come from produced Interceptors. These cost resources, can be destroyed, and need replacement. An empty/depleted Carrier loses damage capacity. Air threats, support, positioning, and Interceptor attrition determine the exchange.

COLOSSUS.name: Colossus
COLOSSUS.description: Tall ground splash unit with cliff-traversing movement and researched extra range. It pressures clustered Light ground forces. Although unable to attack aircraft, it can itself be targeted by anti-air weapons, requiring protection from both air counters and ground flanks.

DARKTEMPLAR.name: Dark Templar
DARKTEMPLAR.acquisition: Gateway + Dark Shrine (powered); or Warp Gate + Dark Shrine (powered).
DARKTEMPLAR.description: Permanently cloaked melee ground attacker. It exploits missing detection and threatens workers/structures, but is easier to contain when revealed. Shadow Stride requires separate research. It may merge with another eligible Templar into an Archon.

DISRUPTOR.name: Disruptor
DISRUPTOR.description: Robotics area-damage unit relying on timed Purification Nova rather than steady normal attacks. Hits punish clumps, while misses, cooldown windows, and friendly fire can waste its investment. It needs protection and maneuvering space between shots.

HIGHTEMPLAR.name: High Templar
HIGHTEMPLAR.acquisition: Gateway + Templar Archives (powered); or Warp Gate + Templar Archives (powered).
HIGHTEMPLAR.description: Ground caster with Feedback and researched Psionic Storm. Its value depends on energy, placement, and protection rather than normal weapon output. Two High/Dark Templar can merge into an Archon, trading future spell options for a fighting unit.

IMMORTAL.name: Immortal
IMMORTAL.description: Robotics ground unit with strong anti-Armored ground damage and temporary Barrier protection. It cannot attack air and needs help against surrounds or unsuitable mass targets. Barrier is temporary protection, not unlimited damage immunity.

MOTHERSHIP.name: Mothership
MOTHERSHIP.description: Large Fleet Beacon-dependent support aircraft with a unique-unit restriction. Area control, recall, and cloak support a fleet rather than replace every army role. The newer cloak command should not be confused with old always-on aura behavior.

OBSERVER.name: Observer
OBSERVER.description: Flying detector/scout, concealed in its normal mode, without a normal attack. Detection works only within coverage, and enemy detection plus anti-air can remove it. Surveillance sacrifices mobility for a wider observation area; its concealment should be evaluated separately.

OBSERVERSIEGEMODE.name: Observer (Surveillance Mode)
OBSERVERSIEGEMODE.acquisition: Transform an existing unit or structure.
OBSERVERSIEGEMODE.description: Stationary Observer mode with extended observation coverage. It cannot follow the army until it leaves the mode. Do not import an older assumption that every Observer state remains cloaked; surveillance concealment changed across balance versions.

ORACLE.name: Oracle
ORACLE.description: Energy-based scout, ground harasser, and control aircraft. Pulsar Beam damages ground units, Revelation tracks/reveals affected enemies, and Stasis Ward traps them. It has no normal anti-air weapon. Energy spent damaging workers is unavailable for later information or control.

PHOENIX.name: Phoenix
PHOENIX.description: Fast anti-air aircraft able to attack while moving and channel Graviton Beam on eligible ground targets. Another source must damage a lifted victim while it channels. It has no normal ground weapon and cannot lift every large target.

PROBE.name: Probe
PROBE.description: Worker for minerals, gas, and initiating structures. After starting a normal warp-in it can return to mining or another task while construction continues. Shields regenerate, but losing health and mining time still causes economic damage. It need not remain as an SCV-style construction worker.

SENTRY.name: Sentry
SENTRY.acquisition: Gateway + Cybernetics Core (powered); or Warp Gate + Cybernetics Core (powered).
SENTRY.description: Support caster with a modest ground/air weapon. Force Field controls movement, Guardian Shield protects against eligible ranged fire, and Hallucination scouts or deceives. These share energy. Protected casting space matters more than treating it as bulk weapon damage.

STALKER.name: Stalker
STALKER.acquisition: Gateway + Cybernetics Core (powered); or Warp Gate + Cybernetics Core (powered).
STALKER.description: Mobile ranged ground/air unit with researched Blink. Flexibility supports positioning and retreat but does not guarantee efficient direct damage against every composition. Blink needs a legal destination and useful vision; aggressive use removes the immediate escape option.

TEMPEST.name: Tempest
TEMPEST.description: Long-range aircraft with separate ground/air attacks. It pressures valuable targets from distance but has slow focused fire and poor close-fighting conditions. Vision and protection realize its range advantage; structure specialization uses a specific upgrade.

VOIDRAY.name: Void Ray
VOIDRAY.description: Ground/air beam aircraft with anti-Armored specialization through Prismatic Alignment. Alignment changes damage and mobility tradeoffs rather than improving every engagement. Unsuitable targets, concentrated fire, and denied retreat can punish the investment.

WARPPRISM.name: Warp Prism
WARPPRISM.description: Robotics-produced flying transport that phases into a power source. Pickup/drops depend on cargo, range, and survival. Phasing supports reinforcements but stops movement. Losing or unphasing the Prism can remove the only power for forward structures and warp-ins.

WARPPRISMPHASING.name: Warp Prism (Phasing Mode)
WARPPRISMPHASING.acquisition: Transform an existing unit or structure.
WARPPRISMPHASING.description: Stationary power-source form of an existing Prism. It enables powered placement and nearby structures. This is not a second transport purchase or a mobile Pylon while phased; changing back removes the power field.

ZEALOT.name: Zealot
ZEALOT.description: Durable melee ground unit without gas cost or anti-air. Charge improves contact; armor, shields, and support affect survival after contact. It absorbs attention and threatens mineral lines but suffers when kited or blocked from reaching a target.

ASSIMILATOR.name: Assimilator
ASSIMILATOR.description: Probe-initiated gas structure on a geyser. Assigned Probes must collect and return gas; the building alone is not income. It needs no Pylon power. Gas allocation competes with minerals needed for workers, structures, and units.

CYBERNETICSCORE.name: Cybernetics Core
CYBERNETICSCORE.description: Gateway-dependent building unlocking Stalker/Sentry/Adept, Robotics, Stargate, Twilight Council, and Shield Battery tech. It researches Warp Gate and air upgrades. It neither produces the unlocked units nor supplies power.

DARKSHRINE.name: Dark Shrine
DARKSHRINE.description: Twilight-dependent Dark Templar technology and teleport researcher. The units come from Gateway/Warp Gate, not the Shrine. Their value depends on detection, positions, and enemy response timing.

FLEETBEACON.name: Fleet Beacon
FLEETBEACON.description: Stargate-dependent advanced air tech unlocking Carrier/Tempest at Stargates and Mothership at Nexus. It hosts air specialization and higher air-upgrade gates. It does not itself produce aircraft.

FORGE.name: Forge
FORGE.description: Pylon-dependent ground weapon/armor/shield researcher and Photon Cannon unlock. Higher research levels also need Twilight Council. Its existence does not provide detection or a defensive weapon.

GATEWAY.name: Gateway
GATEWAY.description: Basic ground producer unlocked by Pylon. Cybernetics Core adds Stalker/Sentry/Adept beyond initial Zealots, while Templar buildings unlock their matching units. Warp Gate research enables individual conversion to a different production mechanism. Operation needs power.

NEXUS.name: Nexus
NEXUS.description: Town hall, collection point, Probe producer, and energy support structure. Chrono Boost accelerates work, Recall brings units home, and Energy Recharge supports eligible energy users in the cached command set. These compete for local energy. Fleet Beacon unlocks Mothership production here.

PHOTONCANNON.name: Photon Cannon
PHOTONCANNON.description: Powered static defense attacking ground and air with detection. Destroying its power can disable it without destroying the Cannon. Position and supporting defenses determine coverage; it cannot move with an advancing army.

PYLON.name: Pylon
PYLON.description: Supply structure and spatial power source. It unlocks Gateway/Forge tech, powers most structures, and supports legal warp-in placement. Destruction can cause both a supply block and local production shutdown. Overlapping power preserves coverage without making the sources invulnerable.

ROBOTICSBAY.name: Robotics Bay
ROBOTICSBAY.description: Facility-dependent technology building unlocking Colossus/Disruptor at the Robotics Facility and hosting relevant range/mobility research. It is not a second independent producer.

ROBOTICSFACILITY.name: Robotics Facility
ROBOTICSFACILITY.description: Producer for Observer, Warp Prism, and Immortal, with Robotics Bay adding Colossus and Disruptor. Support and combat units share its queue. It belongs to the ground-tech branch despite producing flying support units.

SHIELDBATTERY.name: Shield Battery
SHIELDBATTERY.description: Cybernetics-dependent powered shield restoration structure. It spends energy, has no normal weapon, and does not restore health beneath shields. Range, power, energy, and the protected unit's survival constrain its defensive contribution.

STARGATE.name: Stargate
STARGATE.description: Cybernetics-dependent air producer for Phoenix, Oracle, and Void Ray. Fleet Beacon adds Carrier/Tempest. Observer and Warp Prism instead use Robotics capacity; not all flying Protoss units come from a Stargate.

TEMPLARARCHIVE.name: Templar Archives
TEMPLARARCHIVE.description: Twilight-dependent High Templar tech and Psionic Storm researcher. Production still uses Gateway/Warp Gate. Completing the Archives does not automatically grant Storm or unlimited caster energy.

TWILIGHTCOUNCIL.name: Twilight Council
TWILIGHTCOUNCIL.description: Cybernetics-dependent ground specialization for Charge, Blink, Resonating Glaives, Templar branches, and higher Forge upgrades. These investments affect distinct unit families rather than one universal ground boost.

WARPGATE.name: Warp Gate
WARPGATE.acquisition: Transform an existing unit or structure.
WARPGATE.description: Converted Gateway using powered placement and cooldowns for its eligible ground roster. Each gate must be converted after research. It cannot produce Robotics/Stargate units, and complete tech does not remove powered-position requirements.

INTERCEPTOR.name: Interceptor
INTERCEPTOR.description: Small aircraft built/carried by a Carrier to deliver its attacks. Interceptors cost resources, can be destroyed, and need replacement. They are not independently trained by a Stargate or individually purchased main-army fighters.

ADEPTPHASESHIFT.name: Adept Shade
ADEPTPHASESHIFT.description: Temporary Psionic Transfer projection providing information and a possible relocation destination. It is not another damaging Adept. The real unit remains at risk and can cancel rather than commit to the destination.

DISRUPTORPHASED.name: Purification Nova
DISRUPTORPHASED.description: Temporary controlled effect launched by Disruptor. Timed detonation and friendly-fire risk determine damage. It is not an independently purchased unit using a normal attack queue.
